title: National School of Public Policy Amendment Act 2010

sections.shortTitle: National School of Public Policy Amendment Act 2010
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIII OF 2010
ACT XIII OF 2010
NATIONAL SCHOOL OF PUBLIC
POLICY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2010
An Act to amend the National
School of Public
Policy Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I,
23rd April, 2010]
No.F-9(9)/2010-Legis,
dated 23-4-2010.---The following Act of Majlis-e-Shoora
(Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 20th April, 2010, and
is hereby published for general information:--
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the National School of Public Policy Ordinance, 2002
(XCIX of 2002), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as under:--
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the National School of Public Policy
(Amendment) Act, 2010.
(2) It shall come
into force at once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 7th day of
July, 2007.
